mentl/a76d098:
The planned-mint overflow jump is root-only semantics: only the
root's plan seeds mint_high, so an overflow firing with mint_high
still 0 is an unseeded instance — a future branch cursor past its
planned range — and the jump would mint handle 0 over the shared
Module root's cell. Both fresh arms trap that case loudly instead;
the branch protocol stays abort-and-requeue by design. Unreachable
on every root path. CLEAN m2 == m3 at 294435 lines; census 0.
Pin ed5dc82b.
mentl/a715be9:
Three real-workload frontier gates, each cross-validated against an
independent python oracle over the same formulas, every verdict a
discrete fact with wide margins. dsp-crucible: two sinusoids and a
pseudo-noise tone through the <~ recurrence lowpass; the verdict's
DFT argmax reads the FILTERED output, so it is load-bearing on the
filter (the raw signal's louder tone sits in another bin), plus
zero-crossing and clip counts. ml-crucible: batch gradient descent
for a 2-parameter linear regression converging to the planted
truth. adaptive-crucible: a 2-tap LMS filter learning an unknown
channel online while filtering - feedback, float math, and learning
in one loop; residual power drops thirty orders of magnitude. Each
seen RED by perturbation; teaching exit codes kept under WASI's 126
ceiling.

Building the DSP crucible surfaced a latent miscompile: float <~
never assembled. The emit hardcoded the feedback slots (fb_prev,
fb, the state global) to i32, so lib/dsp/feedback.mn's entire
float IIR family was dead codegen - the graph proved the feedback
node's type and the emit fabricated i32. The fix reads
repr_of(lookup_ty(h)) live at both declaration sites. No reachable
wheel site floats a <~, so the fix rode a clean m2 == m3 == m4.

The builder ran isolated in a worktree; the merge was two clean
3-way patches plus the six new fixture files. Frontier 191/0 at the
re-pinned boot; census 0.
mentl/a727b28:
Pre-fix: $ec5_emit_pat_field_binds (emit_control.wat:539) and wheel's
emit_pat_field_binds (wasm.mn:2069) BOTH carried explicit "// nested
ADT destructure — TODO". For wheel-source `match body { NStmt(LetStmt(p,
e)) => ..., NStmt(FnStmt(...)) => ..., NStmt(TypeDefStmt(...)) => ...,
... }`, the seed emitted N arms with IDENTICAL outer body.tag == NStmt
checks; nested inner-Stmt-tag dispatch was skipped. First arm fired for
ANY NStmt → wrong arm body executed → garbage values flowed → mentl2
trapped at infer_pat exhaustive-match unreachable (frame depth 11).

Per protocol_emit_is_graph_projection.md: pat IS a tree in the graph;
emit projects through it. ULTIMATE form: walk the pat tree recursively;
build cumulative `i32.and` predicate at each LPCon depth; bind LPVar
leaves at full offset-paths.

Substrate-honest fix (touches both layers):

bootstrap/src/emit/emit_control.wat (seed):
  - $ec5_emit_pat_field_binds becomes a wrapper that pre-allocates an
    8-slot path buffer + delegates to $ec5_emit_pat_field_binds_path.
  - $ec5_emit_pat_field_binds_path: recursive walk. For LPVar leaf at
    index i, emits chained-load at path + (4 + 4*i) + bind. For LPCon
    sub-pat, recurses with extended path (path[path_len] = field_offset;
    path_len + 1).
  - $ec5_emit_load_chain: emits `(i32.load offset=path[k])` for each
    k in 0..path_len.
  - $ec5_path_extend: list_set + length-counter; mutates the buffer
    in-place (each depth fully owns its slot; sibling recursion at
    same depth overwrites cleanly).
  - $ec5_emit_pat_nested_predicate: walks sub-pats, for each LPCon
    emits chained-load(path) + load offset=field_offset + load offset=0
    + i32.const sub_tag + i32.eq + i32.and. Recursion handles deeper
    nesting via extended path.
  - $ec5_emit_i32_and: byte-emit helper.
  - LPCon arm in emit_match_arms_from: after outer tag check, calls
    emit_pat_nested_predicate to AND-chain sub-pat tag checks (only
    in PureFielded shape — sentinel shape has no field s

turbosort/a78a18a:
Histogram bottleneck is store-forwarding stalls on random-access increments,
not compute. 4-way interleaving maintains 4 independent histogram copies
(64KB stack), processes 4 elements per iteration, then merges — eliminates
stalls at the cost of a merge pass.

Parallel path: per-chunk histograms were computed sequentially despite chunks
being independent. Replaced sequential loop with into_par_iter() — each chunk
owns its own histogram allocation, no aliasing.

clob/a70dbce:
Close the correctness gaps surfaced by the review. Two real fixes (a cache
that couldn't describe its own vocab, a handshake field stubbed to 0) and an
honest audit of the rest.

- .tokens format v2: stamp the encoder's vocab_size into the header. load
  now returns TokenFile { vocab_size, tokens } and rejects the pre-stamp v1
  (regenerate via tokenize_corpus.sh) rather than misparsing it. ingest
  validates the cache's vocab against the model and refuses ids that can't
  index it -- closing the footgun where a .tokens encoded with a large BPE
  could be streamed into a small-vocab model without --tokenizer. clob
  encode writes the stamp.
- KernelConfig::config_hash(): stable FNV-1a-over-bincode fingerprint --
  identical architectures hash equal, any changed hyperparameter differs.
- Peer::connect now advertises a real config_hash (was hardcoded 0 with a
  TODO) and warns when a peer's fingerprint differs, so shape-incompatible
  module exchange is surfaced rather than silently accepted. net connect
  gains --model to fingerprint this kernel; anonymous (0/0) without it.
- net/peer.rs by_trust sorted floats with partial_cmp().unwrap(), which
  panics on NaN; now unwrap_or(Equal).
- Audited the other flagged production unwraps: memory/ring.rs (mutex locks)
  and net/discovery.rs (parsing hardcoded multicast literals) are idiomatic
  and infallible -- left as-is rather than churned.

70 tests pass (cargo test --release); adds config_hash stability and
.tokens v1-rejection tests.

noodles/a73c68c:
The motion system learns the mixer: arm ride, sweep a send knob, and it
records a lane like any pad move. Lanes hold the -30..0 dB knob range
normalized to 0..1; playback inverts it and ramps the send gain per step,
and the first laneless scene restores the mixer's static level exactly
once, the same restore-once contract the patch lanes use. The live path
wakes a parked return before a lane opens its send (threaded through as
mstate.wakeSend); renderOffline scans ride lanes when deciding which
returns to build, because a ride over an all-dry mixer otherwise rendered
dry. Verb and echo knobs join the Sound sheet beside amount and motion,
so the ride surface and the arm live on one page; writes mirror into the
mixer's state. The lane picker, painter, clear, and save/load took the
new lanes without changes - normalizeMotion never whitelisted params.
Send-only lanes skip the per-16th patch ramp bundle, so a ride costs one
gain ramp, not a full applyPatchTo, per step.
